messages.content:
Risk: Confidential data
Description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: If not properly developed to secure confidential data, the model might reveal confidential information or IP in the generated output. Additionally, end users' confidential information might be unintentionally collected and stored.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0031472: Risky behavior — Engaging in dangerous, risky, and potentially self-damaging activities, without considering the consequences, and include physical, health-related, and financial behaviors. It involves a disregard for one's limitations and a denial of personal danger. While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments). [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: Impulsivity, Aggressive behavior, Social disinhibition
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000177: AE risk factor — a disposition that represents a risk factor associated with the occurrence of an adverse event. [found by 3/9 queries]
  Siblings: Surface Tension, adverse effect, contraindication
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 7/9 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualIdentifiers/ContextualIdentificationScheme: contextual identification scheme — identification scheme that applies within one or more contexts [found by 7/9 queries]
  Siblings: driver's license identification scheme, tax identification scheme, national identification number scheme
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00002011: Warning Message — A Message that describes a possible or impending threat. [found by 6/9 queries]
  Siblings: Notification Message, Email Message
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualDesignators/Context: context — situation or frame of reference in which something applies, exists, happens, or is used and that helps to illustrate or explain it [from restriction: isApplicableIn on ContextualIdentificationScheme]

axes.rationale: Confidential data often exists within specific contexts (e.g., patient records, financial transactions). Identifying the relevant contextual identification scheme helps pinpoint where the confidential data resides and how it's managed.
The model itself can act as an agent by generating warning messages when confidential data is detected in the prompt or output. This helps raise awareness and mitigate risks.
